why: Private park known only from one AllStays directory listing (ID 41561: 120 Walsh St N, Fordville, 701-229-3351, May-Sep, 20/30/50 A + water, $$ = $12-20; no website, no reviews, no update date) with no live web presence, checked 2026-11-21: not on the ND HHS statewide licensed RV park/campground list (Updated 07.17.2025, every Fordville licence read: Fordville Dam, John D Hagen RV Park, Kirby's Kamping only); no Google Maps place (gm.py for 'R and J RV Park Fordville ND' and 'R&J RV Park' resolve to 5975 Fordville Dam; the address resolves to a bare street address with no business); not on RV Life (Algolia: 0 name hits, 20 km radius returns only Fordville Dam); not in the Good Sam directory cache (nothing within 25 km); not on RoverPass's Fordville page; web searches for the name and for the phone number return only the AllStays page. Fails both the presence and the price indicator (an AllStays $$ is not an RV Life tier), and no current licence suggests it no longer operates.
name: R and J RV Park
flags: Not a duplicate: the only DB entry within 15 km is 5975 Fordville Dam Recreation Area, 5.0 km SE. No earlier drop at Fordville in audit/verify/removals.json.
Not Kirby's Kamping (205 Dakota St) or John D Hagen RV Park (rural 12851 58th St NE): different addresses; both already skipped for no presence.

Location is AllStays' point, matching the Census geocode of 120 Walsh St N (48.2166,-97.7876). Esri imagery 2026-11-21 (400 m frame, rendered): town grid with houses on both sides of the street, a large building in a shelterbelt to the NE, rail yard and elevator to the S; no row of pads, pedestals or parked RVs legible at or near the point.

Absent from the 07.17.2025 HHS licence list, which carries every other Fordville park, so it is probably closed (or never licensed). Would re-open only if a current website, booking page or Google listing with a nightly rate turns up.
